source: real release poses of dataset 6d6bdce3: blue episodes 7, 11, 12; green episodes 8, 10, 14, 15 (episodes 0-6 are put-downs, 9 has no release, 13 failed grasp). Joint angles = normalized / K, zero at the recorded range midpoint, sign +1 (repo convention; calibration from app/motion/project_robots.json). Forward kinematics: pinned MJCF so101.xml (sha256 982c02c0027ec0c62d3459d0a6eb00dfb7dc13a451992e72ce99addc71f209805), TCP = site gripperframe.
frame: robot base frame = MJCF so101 'base' body; metres; x, y horizontal, z up. Origin = robot base.
plate_height: not determined: release TCP height varies between episodes (blue 0.3 to 1.9 cm, green -0.6 to 4.2 cm), so the plate top is not measured. Use the table-level value only after a physical check.
base_position_top_view: not measured in pixels. Opus 13:52Z (FACTS-LIVE) states the robot base is at the top centre of the top view.

top_view_pixels_640x480.method: green-mask centroid, median over 30 frames of dataset 6d6bdce3 top camera 243622061421 (file-000, first 30 s). Approximate: mask is about 18k px, larger than the plate outline.
top_view_pixels_640x480.blue_plate: not measured (bricks of similar hue confound a blue mask)

uncertainty_horizontal_m.zero_convention_alternative_raw2048: 0.056 blue, 0.063 green. Rejected: under raw-2048 the calibrated lift range would reach -107.8 deg, beyond the 100 deg joint limit (midpoint gives +-99.7 deg).

confidence: low to medium: 3 blue and 4 green releases; zero convention settled by the joint-limit test only; elbow +-5 deg open.
not_for: plate-level training data. The sim blue plate is 3.8 cm from the real blue release and 16.5 deg off in joint-space pan, so sim plate positions must not be used as real plate positions.
